EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No.: EMDS/LND/05/ACQ/02/04-03. Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : LD/05/2007/IR/538. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition (Amended) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude required for a public purpose :

Description of the Land intended to be acquired : Lot Nos. 1 to 11 depicted in the primary plan No. 309 prepared by Survey General in extent of 9.0755 Hectares and Lot Nos. 552 to 565 of polio No. 24, Additional No. 18, of F.V.P. 883 in extent of 15. 1985 Hectares, situated in the Village of Maduwanwela in Kolonna Korale Minor Division in the Embilipitiya Divisional Secretary’s Division in Ratnapura District, Sabaragamuwa Province, bounded as follows;
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Maduwanwela Mukalana; Description of the Land : Open Wastsland; Claimant : State; Extent : 0.6604 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Maduwanwela Mukalana; Description of the Land : Lake and Lake Embankment; Claimant : State; Extent : 6.0942 Hectares.

My No.: D.S/AK/5/1AK/Police. Land Ministry’s Ref. No. : L/03/J/94/D/96. THIS refers to the notice under Section 07 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1004/6 dated Monday, 1st December, 1997 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.

I hereby inform that the date on which the people interested must appear before me regarding those who claim rights in connection with the land acquisition for the Police Station Akmeemana was mentioned as 10.00 a.m. on 23.02.1998 as per the said notice and this will be conducted again at 10.00 a.m. on 19th November, 2024 and the date of informing particulars of their claims should be amended as 12th November, 2024.
T. G. S. Sajeewani, Divisional Secretary, Akmeemana. At Divisional Secretariat Akmeemana, 16th October, 2024. EOG 11 - 0008
